'''{{#expr:113/114 round 3}}''' |bgcolor=#FF8888| [[Torneo Argentino A]] |Indirect |} Note: Clubs with indirect affiliation with [[Asociación del Fútbol Argentino|AFA]] are relegated to the [[Torneo Argentino A]], while clubs directly affiliated face relegation to [[Primera B Metropolitana]]. Clubs with direct affiliation are all from [[Greater Buenos Aires]], with the exception of [[Club Atlético Newell's Old Boys|Newell's]], [[Club Atlético Rosario Central|Rosario Central]], [[Central Córdoba de Rosario|Central Córdoba]] and [[Argentino de Rosario]], all from [[Rosario]], and [[Unión de Santa Fe|Unión]] and [[Colón de Santa Fe|Colón]] from [[Santa Fe, Argentina|Santa Fe]]. The bottom two teams of this table face relegation regardless of their affiliation status. Apart from them, the bottom teams of each affiliation face promotion/relegation playoffs against [[Torneo Argentino A]] and [[Primera B Metropolitana]]'s "Reducido" (reduced tournaments) champions. The Reducidos are played after those leagues' champions are known. Updated as of games played on December 9, 2010.
